title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Malaria Reduction Strategy - Uganda (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Uganda, Malaria, The AIDS Support Organisation (Uganda) Limited (TASO)This program has the following goals: By 2020, reduce annual malaria deaths from 2013 levels to near zero. By 2020, reduce malaria morbidity to 30 cases per 1000 population (80% reduction of the 2013 levels from 150 to 30 cases per 1000 population). By 2020, reduce malaria parasite prevalence to less than 7% (over 85% reduction from the 2010 levels from 45% to 7%). The objectives of this program are: By 2016, the programme is able to manage and coordinate multi-sectoral malaria reduction efforts at all levels.. By 2017 at least 85% of the population practices correct malaria prevention and management measures.. By 2017, achieve and sustain protection of at least 85% of the population at risk through recommended malaria prevention measures.. By 2017, all health faclities and District Health offices report routinely and timely on malaria programme performance.. By 2017, all malaria epidemic prone districts have the capacity for epidemic preparedness and response.. By 2018, achieve and sustain at least 90% of malaria cases in the public and private sectors and community level receive prompt treatment according to national guidelines.
